answer: The jade lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the jetty is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit.
